headline: A problem report can now show the problem
highlights: Exporting “approved files only” now covers ALL the approved files: a leftover row selection no longer silently shrinks the batch. The sheet says which files it covers — everything in the current view by default, with “selected only” one click away.
The export sheet’s Structure menu includes Per character — one folder per character, “Unassigned” for files without one — with names read from the mapping or from hand assignments.
